connector.name: pgvector
connector.registryDescription: Similarity search, hybrid search, and index management for pgvector-backed PostgreSQL tables
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-server-pgvector. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mittalpk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.
